nodes.rationale: React manages pending state and interruption handling while preserving responsiveness.

nodes.label: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates

nodes.label: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: A synchronous pre-hydration script applies client-only state before display, preventing SSR errors and a flash of defaults.

nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: Suppresses warnings only for intentional server-client differences, not genuine hydration bugs.

nodes.label: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
nodes.norm_label: defer state reads to usage point
nodes.rationale: Reading dynamic browser state inside callbacks avoids unnecessary reactive subscriptions.

nodes.label: Use Lazy State Initialization
nodes.rationale: Defers expensive initializer work until the one render where React uses it.

nodes.label: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
nodes.rationale: A shared subscription and callback registry avoids one global listener per component instance.

nodes.norm_label: use defer or async on script tags
nodes.rationale: Prevents scripts from blocking HTML parsing; defer preserves order while async suits independent scripts.

nodes.label: Narrow Effect Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Primitive and derived dependencies reduce needless effect re-execution.

nodes.label: Calculate Derived State During Rendering
nodes.rationale: Render-time derivation avoids redundant state, effects, and state drift.

nodes.label: Subscribe to Derived State
nodes.rationale: A derived boolean subscription avoids rerendering for each continuous-value update.

nodes.label: Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Functional updates use current state, preventing stale closures and stabilizing callbacks.

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers
nodes.rationale: A user action belongs in its handler so unrelated dependency changes cannot duplicate its side effect.

nodes.label: Split Combined Hook Computations
nodes.rationale: Independent computations and effects should have independent dependencies so only necessary work reruns.

nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reduces SVG file size by using precision appropriate to the viewBox.

nodes.label: Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: A nested component creates a new type each parent render, forcing remounts and destroying state.

nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Avoids recreating unchanged JSX during component renders; React Compiler can perform this automatically.

nodes.label: Extract to Memoized Components
nodes.rationale: Component extraction lets loading branches return before expensive work runs.

nodes.label: Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
nodes.norm_label: extract default non-primitive parameter value from memoized component to constant
nodes.rationale: A constant default preserves referential equality and therefore memoization.

nodes.label: Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in usememo
nodes.rationale: Memoization overhead can exceed the cost of a small primitive expression.
